quarterly_data.signal: Management states (FY2026 annual securities report) that, on the rapid spread of generative AI, investment in advanced logic, high-bandwidth memory (HBM) and advanced packaging led the semiconductor market, and new and expanded fabs progressed worldwide for economic security and supply-chain resilience. Semiconductor and electronic components equipment: logic, memory and advanced packaging were strong and orders rose YoY, but sales fell YoY on the adjustment of power-device investment in Japan and China. Display and energy equipment: capex for larger OLED panels (wider OLED adoption in IT products) and retrofit projects lifted orders and sales. Components: vacuum pumps, measurement instruments and power supplies for semiconductor, electronic components and consumer equipment were firm. General industrial equipment: high-performance magnet manufacturing equipment was strong as rare-earth magnet supply-chain diversification investment got fully under way, and leak-test equipment for air conditioners and AI-server cooling systems was firm. Materials: orders and sales rose on continued high utilization at display, semiconductor and electronic components fabs.

Management states (FY2026 annual securities report) that orders hit a record high in FY2026 but, with parts-supply risk materializing and production-capacity constraints, the company could not fully convert the orders it won into sales and profit, and it sees improving profitability as a key issue. It positions FY2027 (year to June 2027) as a year of 'comprehensive review and transformation', with business reform and production reform as top priorities; production reform overhauls production, procurement and logistics, including expanding production capacity, optimizing logistics sites and shortening parts-procurement lead times. Investment will also be directed to 'strengthening production capacity' and 'optimizing production and logistics sites'.

Value-Up Plan (medium- to long-term plan covering the six years from FY June 2026 to FY June 2031; FY2026 annual securities report): targets for the year to June 2028 (interim) net sales of JPY 260 billion or more, operating profit of JPY 39 billion or more, operating margin 15% and ROE 10%; for the year to June 2031 net sales JPY 360 billion, operating profit JPY 79 billion, operating margin 22% and ROE 16% (FY2026 actual: net sales JPY 269.1 billion, operating profit JPY 19.6 billion, margin 7.3%, ROE 7.4%). The company positions AI and data-center-related business as its strategic theme, concentrating resources on focus areas to raise the share of leading-edge, high-value-added projects, centered on logic and memory, advanced packaging and rare-earth magnets, while accelerating a shift to a semiconductor- and electronics-centered portfolio and selling or shrinking businesses with low strategic fit.
quarterly_data.figure: June 2031 targets: net sales JPY 360 billion, operating margin 22%; June 2028 interim: net sales JPY 260 billion or more, operating margin 15%

quarterly_data.signal: FY2026 R&D (annual securities report): R&D expenses JPY 14,611 million (up JPY 620 million; 5.4% of net sales, -0.2 points), of which Vacuum Equipment JPY 13,587 million and Vacuum Application JPY 1,024 million; the company will keep investing to strengthen R&D centered on semiconductors and electronics. In semiconductor equipment it is developing equipment and deposition processes to enter other process steps building on its metal-hard-mask track record in leading-edge logic, and in memory to enter other steps in DRAM and 3D NAND as scaling and layer counts advance; this led to the new model ENTRON-EXX, which adds extensibility and stronger data collection and analysis while keeping the ENTRON series' single and tandem platforms.
quarterly_data.figure: R&D expenses JPY 14,611 million (5.4% of net sales)

quarterly_data.signal: Other FY2026 R&D (annual securities report): the company newly joined imec's industry-academia program; developed and released the EWL-030, a 300mm-wide roll-to-roll lithium-metal vacuum evaporation system, from a NEDO Green Innovation Fund project on lithium-metal anode production for next-generation batteries; is developing dilution refrigerators and 4K cryocoolers for quantum computers and medical uses; and is developing low-particle mechanisms and new units for larger, higher-resolution OLED display equipment. Vacuum Application R&D covers sputtering target materials, surface analysis instruments and mask blanks for semiconductor and FPD lithography.

FY2026 capex (annual securities report): JPY 17,990 million, of which Vacuum Equipment JPY 14,138 million (evaluation and R&D machinery for the semiconductor and electronic components equipment and display and energy equipment businesses) and Vacuum Application JPY 3,852 million (mask-blank manufacturing equipment, etc.). The report states no significant new facility plans and no significant disposals.
quarterly_data.figure: Capex JPY 17,990 million (Vacuum Equipment JPY 14,138 million; Vacuum Application JPY 3,852 million)

quarterly_data.signal: FPD sputtering-target business integration (annual securities report, material contracts and business-combination notes): on 05-16-2026 Ulvac signed an agreement to transfer all its equity in its consolidated subsidiary in Suzhou, China (development, production and sale of FPD sputtering targets) to Beijing Fengke Jingsheng Electronic Materials, a joint venture controlled by a Beijing fund with Ningbo Jiangfeng Electronic Materials (KFMI) as a local partner, under a Master Framework Agreement to combine Ulvac's and KFMI's FPD target businesses; the transfer was completed on 06-25-2026 and the subsidiary left consolidation. As part of the same integration, Korean subsidiary Pure Surface Technology spun off its FPD target business into the newly established UFOMAT Korea, Ltd., completed 08-24-2026. The company cites the changing competitive environment in the Chinese market.
